payload.description:
GitPython 3.1.60 removed `Actor.name_email_regex`. python-semantic-release 10.6.1 still reads that attribute on every config load, so `semantic-release version` fails in the reusable workflow.

Plexus main CI succeeded after #615; Release failed with:

`type object 'Actor' has no attribute 'name_email_regex'`

Upstream: python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release#1476

Fix: install `GitPython<3.1.60` next to `python-semantic-release` in the reusable workflow until PSR ships a release that does not use the removed attribute.
payload.title: Pin GitPython below 3.1.60 so semantic-release can load config
